summary: Feed s102_single is degraded: encrypted share is 93.7% exceeding NDR tolerance of 90%. All other checks (duplicates, missing VLAN, one-way, packet drops, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: 93.7% of bytes are encrypted (TLS) exceeding the NDR's 90% threshold. Traffic is predominantly TLS-encrypted without broker-assisted decryption, so payload remains opaque to the NDR.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires full payload for deep inspection and behavioral detection. High encryption blinds signatures, JA3/JA4, and anomaly detection, reducing coverage for C2, exfiltration and lateral movement hidden in TLS.

recommended_fix.why: Restore payload visibility by enabling selective TLS decryption at the packet broker/proxy (with proper key management/escrow) and forwarding a decrypted copy to the NDR, or routing decrypted traffic to this NDR while keeping encrypted traffic for metadata-only tools. This brings effective encrypted share below 90% tolerance.
